service.considerations.siteVisit: A site visit may be needed when an inspection or measurements are needed.
service.limits.heading: Is there anything you don't do?
service.limits.excluded: We don't do licensed trade work (gas, line-voltage electrical, plumbing or HVAC), structural work, or asbestos, lead or mold work.
service.limits.hazmat: If asbestos, lead or mold is suspected, the affected work stops. We do no sampling or testing.
service.limits.access: We use ladders only and do no roof-edge work.
service.limits.homeAge1978: We don't take on paint-disturbing work in homes built before 1978.
service.limits.popcorn1981: We remove popcorn ceilings only in homes built in 1981 or later.
service.limits.fireplaceMounting: We don't mount items over fireplaces.
service.limits.burnerPorts: We don't clear gas burner ports.
service.limits.roofEdgeGuards: We don't install roof-edge gutter guards.
service.limits.acidGroutHaze: We don't remove grout haze with acid.
